[[File:World of Warcraft Trading Card Game original Upper Deck logo.png|thumb|Original World of Warcraft TCG game logo.]]
'''World of Warcraft Trading Card Game''' is a collectible card game based on Blizzard Entertainment's online game ''World of Warcraft''. Upper Deck Entertainment introduced it with ''Heroes of Azeroth'' on 25 October 2006. Mike Hummel, Brian Kibler, and Danny Mandel are credited with designing its game engine.<ref name="rules">[https://www.retzlaff-web.de/aessina/downloads/wow_rulebook_de.pdf World of Warcraft Trading Card Game Official Rulebook (German edition)], Upper Deck Entertainment, credits. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261107200930/https://www.retzlaff-web.de/aessina/downloads/wow_rulebook_de.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref>[https://icv2.com/print/article/9476 World of Warcraft release report], ICv2, 16 October 2006. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20250813160605/https://icv2.com/print/article/9476 Internet Archive].</ref>

== Gameplay ==

Players build around an Alliance or Horde hero, using allies, abilities, and equipment to defeat the opposing hero. Quests serve as resources and can be completed for rewards.<ref name="rules" />

== Publication ==

Cryptozoic Entertainment acquired the license in March 2010 and continued publishing the game. In August 2013, Blizzard announced that the line's 21st set, ''Timewalkers: Reign of Fire'', would be its last and that official tournaments would end.<ref>[https://warcraft.blizzplanet.com/cryptozoic_entertainment_acquires_world_of_warcraft_trading_card_game_licen/ Cryptozoic Entertainment Acquires World of Warcraft Trading Card Game License], Cryptozoic Entertainment press release, 24 March 2010, reproduced by Blizzplanet. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261107201653/https://warcraft.blizzplanet.com/cryptozoic_entertainment_acquires_world_of_warcraft_trading_card_game_licen/ Internet Archive].</ref><ref>[https://worldofwarcraft.blizzard.com/en-us/news/10734217/juego-de-cartas-tcg-de-world-of-warcraft World of Warcraft Trading Card Game], Blizzard Entertainment, 24 August 2013. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261107201734/https://worldofwarcraft.blizzard.com/en-us/news/10734217/juego-de-cartas-tcg-de-world-of-warcraft Internet Archive].</ref>

== Online play ==

The [[TCGMix]] playtest uses the ''Heroes of Azeroth'' set and lets players lead Alliance or Horde heroes.<ref name="catalog" />

Players can [https://tcgmix.com/wowtcg/ open the game on TCGMix].<ref name="tcgmix-play-world-of-warcraft-tcg">[https://tcgmix.com/wowtcg/ Play World of Warcraft TCG], TCGMix. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261107195437/https://tcgmix.com/wowtcg/ Internet Archive].</ref>
